tools.name: search_captains
tools.description: Search bookable charter captains, optionally filtered by harbor, with sorting and pagination. Returns a paginated list with starting price and rating.

tools.name: search_boats
tools.description: Search listed boats, optionally filtered by harbor, type, minimum capacity, and max hourly price, with sorting and pagination.

tools.name: get_captain
tools.description: Get a captain's full profile by tenant slug, enriched with a rating summary and the most recent reviews.

tools.name: get_boat
tools.description: Get a boat's full profile by id, enriched with a rating summary and the most recent reviews.

tools.name: list_harbors
tools.description: List active harbors, each with a count of active captains and listed boats operating there.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check a captain's or boat's availability. Provide exactly one of captainSlug or boatId. Omit date to get available dates for the next 90 days; provide both date (YYYY-MM-DD) and durationHours to get bookable time slots for that date. Only departures that have not yet left (Chicago time) are listed,

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get a non-binding price quote (in cents) for a charter or rental. Provide exactly one of captainSlug or boatId, plus durationId and partySize.
